synthesis.trait: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps
Shows personal warmth and respect for John beneath the professional friction between them

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps
turning_points.what_changes: Moves from a verbal statement of John's role limits to a concrete institutional action -- denying John's lead-role request and calling in the Bureau -- a materially higher-cost enforcement of authority than simply laying out rules.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps
turning_points.what_changes: Directly continues the same unbroken exchange, doubling down on the Bureau decision with justification rather than a new, separate escalation.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps
turning_points.what_changes: Closes out the same conversation with the definitive dismissal 'Your job is done here' -- the terminal beat of the same sequence begun at scene120_beat6.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Shows personal warmth and respect for John beneath the professional friction between them
turning_points.what_changes: Explicitly names 'our obvious differences in methodology,' concretely recalling the earlier institutional conflict (Bureau call-in), then reverses it into gratitude and an invocation of John's father's pride -- releasing the antagonism into resolution rather than requiring either side to 'win.'

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Enforces institutional authority and procedural boundaries over John's outside-consultant role, issuing direct orders and reprimands when John oversteps
